configuration.status: partial display harness study with removable grip hardware and a rear cable guard
configuration.coordinate_frame: installed X, Y and height above the base bottom, in mm
configuration.module_connector_basis: Nominal solid in the saved native PCB export, matched to the 26.25 x 3.95 x 1.05 mm connector shell in the official Mu Ultra STEP. The module drawing identifies the connector at this edge; cable exit is +X.
configuration.radius_basis: Space-study requirement only. The I-PEX 20453 revision 38 drawing says to confirm bend radius with the harness maker; it does not establish this assembly's static or repeated-flex limit.
configuration.fanout_basis: Available tapering space, not an approved wire lay or connector assembly. The complete terminated plug, fanout and first bend must be drawn by the harness maker.
configuration.opening_basis: User-selected 135 degree opening, matching the saved stop prototype. Loads and the assembled opening tolerance still need qualification.
configuration.anchor_basis: Split metal jaw prototypes with flush screws, reinforcement mounts and removable lining. Cable compression, pull retention and mounting loads still need qualification.
configuration.case_changes_scope: The reliefs are applied only to the separate display-hinge study, not to the saved full case.
configuration.grip_liner_status: 3.7 mm outside / 3.1 mm inside split lining prototype around the 3 mm cable budget. It has 0.1 mm diametral clearance and is not a qualified friction clamp.
configuration.module_plug_check_scope: A documented connector-family reference is positioned at the saved port datum. Exact installed part identity, mating compatibility and physical operation remain unconfirmed.

guard_removal.sequence: Open to 105 degrees, remove the deck and both guard screws/washers, then close the lid before sliding the guard rearward. Reopen to work on the jaws.

mounting_hardware.liner_collision_scope: The 0.3 mm cable-position allowance overlaps the lining inside its two defined jaws. Those exact pairs use the separate 3 mm nominal cable gauge; all other solid pairs remain checked.
limits: Nominal sampled movements do not prove continuous clearance or fit across manufacturing tolerances.
The lining currently has clearance; friction, compression, material and pull retention must be established with the selected cable.
Thread engagement does not include incomplete lead threads and does not establish joint strength.
The cable guard covers the straight section; the moving-tail opening is not sealed.

configuration.status: documented connector-family fit study; exact installed suffix and pin-1 orientation unconfirmed
configuration.bar_pivot_basis: X-axis through the wire centre. The CAD crossbar centre is Y0.455,Z2.835. The drawing's 4.40 mm inner spacing plus 0.55 mm uncoated wire diameter gives 4.95 mm centre spacing, placing the pivot at Z-2.115. Internal latch deformation is not modeled.
configuration.bar_swing_scope: Enclosure clearance through both horizontal positions; follow the supplier's handling sequence on the actual part rather than forcing an assumed travel limit.
configuration.upper_swing_space_scope: An additional room allocation above the seated connector. The lower seating region is covered by the nominal part check, not by this box. This is not a full manufacturing-tolerance proof.
configuration.service_prerequisites: Release the display base jaw and free the loom before unplugging. Disconnect or release the fan/USB guides attached to the keyboard carrier before removing it. The complete keyboard removal sequence and dressed-cable handling still need a physical check.
configuration.access_note: Clearance corridors for narrow insulating tools. Their size and position do not define an approved pressing tool, force, or a safe contact point on an unconfirmed connector.

module_plug_checks.excluded_interface_scope: Only the uniquely identified native port solid is excluded for this bought connector-family reference. The module PCB and every other module component remain checked. This does not verify interchangeability with the installed connector.
limits: The reference archive predates the latest drawings and is used for family packaging only.
Bar rotation uses a drawing-derived pivot. Internal latch and hinge contact, release force and elastic deformation are outside this enclosure check.
The upper room allocation covers space above the connector, not all possible manufacturing variation at the mating interface.
Release the base jaw and free the loom before unplugging; wire strain during manipulation is not predicted.
The keyboard/carrier removal sequence and actual insulating-tool contact points need a physical check.

internal_check_scope: Common-frame pairs and pairs with the rotation-invariant axis cylinder are checked once. Other moving-versus-fixed pairs use the full opening sample range. Adjacent volumes representing the same continuous cable are not treated as independent physical parts.
helix_note: Illustrative outer path at 1.5 mm radius with uniformly distributed twist. This is not a material strain or fatigue prediction; actual wire lay, sliding, slack and strain concentration are unknown.
